sar.narrative: On 2016-12-29, account C11923-K2 was investigated after transaction 3583368 for $131.30 was flagged. The activity occurred through product code C using online at an online transaction without a billing-region field. The investigation identified 11 transaction(s) in the same episode between 2016-12-29 and 2016-12-29, totaling $355.34. The identity record marked the device as New for this account and the graph linked the profile to 2 other known card(s). The customer reported the transaction as unauthorized. The graph and prior-case memory were used to compare the activity with historical investigations and connected entities. The evidence was assessed as consistent with card not present new device and the account was handled under the applicable fraud policy. The final case record recommends the actions listed in the investigation, including regulatory reporting because the policy trigger was met.

stop_reason: Customer/analyst evidence settled the decision under the policy; further investigation was not expected to change the action.
